title: Split hooks/test_guard.py into one test file per guard rule
why: hooks/test_guard.py is a busy file: lanes that touch it clash in batches, and clashes drove 147 lane drops across the last 15 batch merges (retrospective audit 09:37 CST Nov 11). One file per rule lets lanes on different rules stack without a conflict.
note: Ruling R26 part 4 (owner box answer 10:05 CST Nov 11, "Both"; plan 3581e5a under item 3.4): run it first in stage 3, while few lanes are open. Its twin: the batch runner puts lanes on the same busy file (hooks/guard.py, hooks/test_guard.py, hooks/mutate_guard.py) in back-to-back stacked batches, never one batch (home: decision batch-freeze-lane-set, step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce). Held with stage 3 until the batch strategy is settled (R25).
source: owner 2026-11-11 10:05 CST, relayed by the retrospective session
